Inherited bilirubin metabolism disorder; common forms do not cause hepatic tissue damage. Neurologic injury is confined to severe subtypes.
Inherited thoracic aortic aneurysm/dissection; skeletal, skin and ocular findings occur below 30%.
Benign cutaneous proliferation of keratinocytes and melanocytes.
Malignancy originating in peripheral or autonomic nervous tissue; other organ sites vary across subtypes.
Localized cutaneous mucin deposition with papules and fibrosis; thyroid disease is explicitly absent.
Carcinoma arising in the rete ovarii, a reproductive structure outside the axes; ovarian origin does not establish endocrine dysfunction.
Presynaptic neuromuscular transmission disorder with motor neuropathy; fixed foot deformities in 70-80% and distal muscle atrophy in 40%. Hearing impairment 20%.
Lymphoid-cell malignancy arising in the cecum; bowel origin and lymphoma mechanism define the axes.
Skeletal/ectodermal dysplasia with nephronophthisis in 2/2; cirrhosis in 1/2. Pulmonary artery stenosis and dental hypoplasia, each 1/2, omitted at cap; sample is small.

Autoantibodies directly destroy red blood cells, causing hemolytic anemia.
Immune-mediated lichenoid skin inflammation producing thick plaques and potentially permanent scarring.
Occlusive disease of pulmonary venules and capillaries causes pulmonary hypertension and intrinsic pulmonary gas-exchange impairment.
Acute myeloid leukemia defined by t(1;22); malignant myeloid cells occupy marrow and disrupt blood production.
Localized dermal elastic-tissue abnormality causes persistent skin laxity. Hyperesthesia alone does not establish nerve damage.
Neurodevelopmental disorder with seizures, dystonia and brain abnormalities; constipation and feeding difficulties do not establish intrinsic gastrointestinal damage.
Energy metabolism defect; muscle injury supported by elevated CK in 80-99% and myoglobinuria in 30-79%; palmoplantar hyperkeratosis 30-79%. Renal insufficiency below 30%.
Peroxisomal metabolic disorder with leukoencephalopathy and neuropathy; hearing impairment reported in 1/1, with limited frequency certainty. Hypogonadism shares endocrine axis.
Defined by neurodevelopmental impairment, skeletal anomalies and pigmentary mosaicism; heart failure and pulmonary arterial hypertension annotated in 80-99%.
Craniosynostosis with maxillary retrusion and intellectual disability; dental malocclusion with open bite occurs in 30-79%. Ventriculomegaly is occasional.
